test_yaml_dump: test the yaml_dump function to serialize a dictionary to YAML string with unicode support
test_yaml_dump_no_unicode: test the yaml_dump function with allow_unicode=False to escape unicode characters as \U codes
test_soft_temporary_directory: test the SoftTemporaryDirectory context manager to create and auto-delete a temporary directory
test_weak_file_lock_timeout: test the WeakFileLock class to acquire a lock and raise Timeout when already locked
test_weak_file_lock_logging: test the WeakFileLock class to verify lock waiting logs are emitted at INFO level
